description.value: Beauty For Ashes is a specialty African grocery and beauty products store carrying authentic West and Central African staples — including gari, palm oil, dried fish, pap varieties, plantain chips, and fresh vegetables — that are difficult to find elsewhere in the Lower Mainland. The Burnaby location is one of two stores (the other in Surrey), and the business also offers online ordering with delivery via Genie Delivery and in-store pickup. A touring cyclist looking for an unusual resupply stop would find a broad range of packaged and fresh African food products here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at africanmarket.ca confirms this is an active African grocery and beauty products store; the contact page explicitly lists 7667 6th Street as the Burnaby location with phone 604-553-4745, matching the OSM address but contradicting the OSM community field of 'North Vancouver'. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, bike rack, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields remain null. Basic groceries are clearly confirmed by the extensive product catalogue covering dry goods, frozen food, vegetables, fish, and snacks.
